question: Should Wave 2+ modular dashboard capabilities remain a bundled OpenClaw Control UI/Gateway roadmap, and which child items should move to plugin or ClawHub distribution instead?
rationale: The tracker spans product direction, persistent widget/workspace state, browser sandboxing, registry/install trust, and role visibility boundaries that cleanup automation cannot choose safely.

options.title: Sponsor Selectively
options.body: Keep the roadmap open, review linked child issues and PRs one by one, and require explicit storage and security boundaries before each merge.

options.title: Move Optional Pieces Outward
options.body: Keep only generic core/API seams in OpenClaw and direct optional widget packs, skills, registries, and app bundles to plugin or ClawHub paths.

options.title: Defer The Roadmap
options.body: Pause Wave 2+ dashboard work if maintainers decide bundled modular dashboards are not current product work.

recommendation.title: Sponsor Selectively
recommendation.body: Keep the roadmap open, review linked child issues and PRs one by one, and require explicit storage and security boundaries before each merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current-main ownership signal is the Logbook/control-tab architecture and adjacent product-security boundary work.
